titulo: Andy Burnham and EU leaders speak after reaching agreement on reset deal – live
cuerpo: UK statement comes after EU said deal would not take effect without future agreement over university tuition fees Senior correspondent Making today’s reset deal contingent on a further agreement on the level of tuition fees for EU citizens is designed to neutralise the leverage London gets in the next six months, EU sources have said. Senior diplomats had already confirmed this week that the EU would defer the deal on the level of tuition fees for another six months , a move designed to give the UK leverage in parallel negotiations to have the UK included in Made in Europe legislation designed to protect EU supply chains against China. But the move to make the food and drink deal also contingent on a tuition fees deal effectively seeks to neutralise the leverage the UK gets today. This is a serious chess game and shows the EU, again, is willing to speak very warmly about the UK but will play absolute hard ball when it comes to conceding any points to a former member state. It was the same point France was making last night insisting the UK could not have voting rights on legislation in relation to food and drink.
